about: Ledger of the saboteur corpus identifiers (test/saboteur-corpus.js), kept as the attack corpus ledger is (ADR-0087): append-only; a new case takes the next number; a removed case moves to `retired` with the date and the reason, and its number is never given again. Each identifier is pinned to its case name. Guarded by test/unit/saboteur-corpus.test.js.
